scenario: Agent and customer refer to a stored card by its last four digits only.
notes: Deliberate negative control. Last-four references are permitted under PCI DSS, so detections here are not failures — they are over-redaction, which costs summary quality. Expected list is intentionally empty.

conversation.text: I see a card on file ending in 4242. Would you like me to charge that one?
Yes, the card ending in 4242 is fine. It's the one I always use.
Done. The receipt is on its way to the address we have on file.
